description: Returns the dentalunlock.com page where a dentist can upload a dental employment contract for an A-F grade, and describes what the free grade and the optional full analysis include. Relevant when a dentist asks whether an associate contract or job offer is fair, about red flags, non-competes, or negotiating. The review itself happens on dentalunlock.com. General information, not legal advice.
name: grade_dental_contract_link
title: Grade a dental employment contract
